artifacts.name: FCOA Canonical Memory & Intelligence Fabric Node

capability_deltas: FUSE Ecosystem v1 is the umbrella provider-neutral product/runtime facade over the existing Federation; it does not create a new sovereign controller.

Sixteen provider-neutral ecosystem services now cover deep research, agent action, multi-agent orchestration, model council, agentic coding, creative studio, data analytics, enterprise workflows, enterprise knowledge, durable memory, computer/device control, security, observability, capability marketplace, artifact workspace and enterprise communications.

Mission routing now starts from logical ecosystem services and required capabilities, then uses shared Capability Truth/currentness to choose primary and backup adapters across independent provider failure domains.

FCOA and the Platform Specialist Corps share the same currentness truth substrate; currentness may preserve or downgrade route eligibility but cannot upgrade unverified semantics or grant external authority.

The market-composite map clean-room harvests public capability mechanisms such as deep research, browser/API/terminal/computer action, multi-agent systems, model councils, subagents/hooks/checkpoints, MCP/A2A-style interoperability, low-code workflows, creative orchestration, observability and capability marketplaces into replaceable FUSE contracts.
Existing provider-backed projections CROSS_ESTATE_CURRENTNESS and CROSS_ESTATE_ROUTE_SCORECARD remain the runtime truth source for adapter maturity and redundancy.
route_deltas: Resolve every substantial mission through FUSE Ecosystem service IDs before considering a vendor/provider route.
Use Capability Truth/currentness and the route scorecard to select a primary adapter plus independent backups where the service requires failure-domain diversity.
Prefer existing FUSE capabilities and clean-room market-composite mechanism harvest before building residual capability.
Keep user-facing interaction unified through the FUSE AI/LocalLLM shell while provider-specific tools remain behind replaceable adapters.

For agentic coding use plan/edit/test/checkpoint/review loops; for research require citation/provenance; for creative work prefer existing assets then task-classified Canva/Adobe routes; for enterprise workflows use durable/event-driven providers; for computer use require live readback.
Never promote an ecosystem service to LIVE from source admission alone; action-specific currentness and semantic readback remain mandatory.
summary: Promote FUSE Ecosystem v1 as the umbrella provider-neutral market-composite product/runtime facade across the Federation.
warnings: FUSE Ecosystem v1 is a service facade over existing controllers, not a new controller.
Individual service maturity remains capability-specific; ecosystem admission does not make stale/source-only provider adapters live.
Effectful external actions, credentials, IAM, publishing, spending and human-facing messages remain separately authority-gated.
Gemini task-specific execution, Google-native unattended scheduling, Windows live physical control and Copilot runtime remain separate open proof boundaries.
